messages:
maya (sec): Alert from audit: sharp increase in KMS decrypt denies after RBAC release at 02:30 UTC. Regions: eu-central-1 + ap-northeast-1. Sample: `2026-03-22T02:35:04Z principal=svc-keystore@eu-central-1 error=AccessDenied` and sidecar log `tls: no certificate available for host`.

tom (infra): looking. The PR narrowed keystore principals; policy-gen removed some tagged legacy roles. Could be our policy exception logic.

keywatcher-bot: key-rotation job failed: service=key-rotator region=ap-northeast-1 attempt=7 err=KMSAccessDenied. Next retry 40s.

raj (sre): impact: new pod restarts and scale-ups hit TLS handshake fails; long-lived connections unaffected. Traffic drops for a few minutes in some services.

anna (product): any customer-facing 5xxs? we should prep comms if it expands.

maya (sec): Not yet at scale, but we should treat as potential SEV-3. Start with quick mitigations.

tom (infra): options: 1) add temporary kms:Decrypt allow for `arn:aws:iam::333:role/keystore-legacy-*` scoped to affected regions, 2) rollback the policy, 3) pause rotation in those regions. I propose 3 + 1.

raj (sre): agree. Pause rotator to stop churn and add targeted allow so pending unwrapps can finish. I'll trigger pause. Command: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/key-rotator ROTATION_ENABLED=false --region=eu-central-1,ap-northeast-1`.

keywatcher-bot: Verified: ROTATION_ENABLED=false in eu-central-1,ap-northeast-1. Pending unwrap queue: 12 -> draining.

tom (infra): IAM patch prepared (temp allow) with expiry tag `exp:2026-03-22T04:00:00Z`. Deploying now. Snippet: `Action: kms:Decrypt Principal: arn:aws:iam::333:role/keystore-legacy-* Condition: aws:RequestedRegion = [eu-central-1,ap-northeast-1]`

maya (sec): add an audit rule: alert on Decrypt AccessDenied spikes and a second alert on Decrypt denies after allow flips (to catch regressions). Also log the policy commit id and PR link in the incident doc.

raj (sre): post-mitigation checks: TLS handshake error rate down 92% in 5m. No customer 5xxs seen in last 10m. I'll keep the alert active for 24h.

tom (infra): root cause: policy-generator name-normalization dropped wildcarded legacy roles when tag parsing failed. Fix: respect explicit exceptions + run a KMS-decrypt smoke during canary rollout. PR opened: https://git.internal/policy-gen/pulls/401 - includes unit tests for tag parsing.

maya (sec): followups: 1) add KMS decrypt smoke to CI, 2) update runbook to include pause-rotation step, 3) add a small integration test verifying proxy PEM-cache fallback during rotation, 4) review cipher-suite policy to avoid tight failures for older clients during cross-region handshakes.

anna (product): I'll draft a short customer note: "minor rotation disruption mitigated; no data exposure; rotation paused and policy fix deployed; permanent fix in progress."

maya (sec): owners: tom (fix), raj (monitor). Assign SEV-3. Closing channel for ongoing async followups. :lock:
